run_settings.beams: e- 18 GeV (EL-BEAM 18D0 0.0D0 -1, unpolarised) x p 275 GeV (PR-BEAM 275D0 0.0D0, unpolarised); NUCLEUS 275D0 1.0D0 1.0D0 (A = Z = 1)
run_settings.kinem_cuts: ICUT = 3: 1e-5 <= x_l <= 1, 1e-4 <= y_l <= 1, Q2 bin edges on Q2_l, W_h >= 3.0 GeV (manual: cuts on the LEPTONIC variables x_l, y_l, Q2_l and on the hadronic final-state mass)
run_settings.structure_functions: STRUCTFUNC 0 2 10150 = LHAPDF5 set 10150, CTEQ6.1M central (the logs load cteq61.LHgrid member 0); LO
run_settings.rad_1: GSW-PARAM 2 1 3 1 1 1 2 1 1 1 1; INT-OPT-NC 1 18 18 18 18 0 0 0 0, i.e. INC2 = 1 (non-radiative incl. virtual + soft), INC31..INC34 = 18 (initial-state lepton, final-state lepton, Compton, quark-line radiation -- INC34 'not active in DJANGOH' per the manual), IEL2 = IEL31 = IEL32 = IEL33 = 0
run_settings.IMPORTANT_elastic_tail_off: IEL2 = IEL31 = IEL32 = IEL33 = 0 in ALL EIGHT logs (checked 2026-09-23): per the manual these are elastic ep -> ep and the 'quasielastic tail ep -> ep gamma' from initial-state, final-state and Compton radiation. So Rad=1 / Rad=0 here is the INELASTIC O(alpha) correction ONLY, with the ELASTIC RADIATIVE TAIL SWITCHED OFF.

units: microbarn, per e-p collision (A = 1: per nucleus = per nucleon)
ratio_note: sigma_rad1/sigma_rad0 is NOT stored: the harness computes it from the two columns (1.072454 / 1.089407 / 1.160626 / 1.227965).
